site.name: Balcony Music Club
site.core_summary: Founded in 2011. No cover. No charge. Live music, haunted-history energy, fresh-made-to-order chicken paninis, specialty cocktails, THC seltzers, and craft beer at 504 Esplanade.
site.house_atmosphere: NO COVER • NO CHARGE • 504 ESPLANADE • LIVE MUSIC • HAUNTED-HISTORY ENERGY • COCKTAILS • THC SELTZERS • CRAFT BEER
site.poster_caption: A haunted New Orleans live-music room with marquee glow, no cover, patio backbar paninis, and a house drink list worth asking about.
site.sidebar_summary: JazzyCat is the fast BMC guide for guests who want music, drinks, food, haunted-history context, the current address, or private-event contacts without digging around.
site.marketing_line: Whether you’re looking for a craft cocktail in New Orleans, a courtyard bar at 504 Esplanade, or the perfect start to your night, BMC is the move.

live_music.short_answer: Live music runs every Wednesday through Sunday, open to close. For the newest lineup, check the Shows page or BMC app.

bloody_mary_brunch.short_answer: Build Your Own Bloody Mary Sunday Brunch is every Sunday from noon to 4:00 PM. It is $15, and refills are $10.

paint_and_sip.ticket_note: One ticket with one complimentary drink: $35. Two tickets with two complimentary drinks: $60.
paint_and_sip.short_answer: For Paint and Sip registration, call or text 504-428-5494. One ticket with one complimentary drink is $35; two tickets with two complimentary drinks are $60.

private_events.short_answer: Book the courtyard, speakeasy, balcony bar, or main stage for weddings, graduations, Mardi Gras balls, private celebrations, and receptions. Contact BMC@marullomgmt.com or 504-428-5494.

happy_hour.short_answer: Thursday happy hour runs from 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM with cocktail lounge music.

haunted_tours.public_summary: BMC sits inside the haunted-history conversation of old New Orleans: a live room on Esplanade with ghost-tour energy, old-city atmosphere, music, drinks, and stories moving through the night.
haunted_tours.guest_answer: Haunted-history tours and ghost-tour guests can treat BMC as a good Esplanade stop before or after a route. This page does not claim a specific named ghost, but the room leans into the old New Orleans haunted-bar mood: history, music, courtyard shadows, and late-night stories.
haunted_tours.what_to_ask_staff: Ask the staff what stories guests usually bring in after tours and what the room has been feeling like that night.
haunted_tours.after_tour_suggestion: After a haunted-history tour, stop in for no-cover live music, a cocktail, a THC seltzer, craft beer, or a fresh chicken panini from the patio backbar.

food.patio_backbar: The patio backbar serves fresh-made-to-order chicken paninis.
food.guest_answer: Food-wise, ask for the patio backbar chicken paninis: hot, fresh-made-to-order, and built for people who want something satisfying between drinks, sets, or tour stops.

menu.headline: Specialty craft cocktails, THC seltzers, craft beer, and patio backbar bites.

categories.name: Specialty Craft Cocktails
categories.description: A music-themed house cocktail list with bright, refreshing, tropical, whiskey-warm, and dessert-leaning options. Ask JazzyCat by mood or spirit.

categories.name: THC Seltzers
categories.description: A mellow canned option alongside the cocktail list. Availability can vary, so ask the bar what is cold today.

categories.name: Craft Beer
categories.description: Cold craft selections for beer drinkers who want something easy before or between sets. Ask the bar for the current lineup.

categories.name: Patio Backbar
categories.description: Fresh-made-to-order chicken paninis from the patio backbar round out the house menu.

signature_cocktails.name: The BMC
signature_cocktails.brief: A cool, bright house cocktail with minty snap, citrus lift, and a playful late-night edge.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: The BMC is the house cocktail: cool, bright, minty, and citrusy. You can take it with tequila, vodka, gin, or rum, so it works for a lot of drinkers.

signature_cocktails.name: Etta Jameson
signature_cocktails.brief: Smooth and expressive with whiskey warmth, soft orchard sweetness, and a tangy finish.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: Etta Jameson is the whiskey pick: smooth, warm, lightly sweet, and a little tangy on the finish.

signature_cocktails.name: Jimi Hendrix Fizz
signature_cocktails.brief: Floral, sparkling, and slightly dreamy — a gin-forward fizz with a polished finish.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: The Jimi Hendrix Fizz is floral, bubbly, and gin-forward — a lighter, sparkling cocktail with a polished finish.

signature_cocktails.name: Uptown Funk
signature_cocktails.brief: Bright, tropical, and punchy with lime-driven freshness and a sunny groove.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: Uptown Funk is bright, tropical, and limey — the lively sunny one.

signature_cocktails.name: Muddy Waters
signature_cocktails.brief: Rich, dark, and dessert-leaning with coffeehouse depth and chocolate mood.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: Muddy Waters is the rich one: dark, coffeehouse-style, chocolatey, and dessert-leaning.

signature_cocktails.name: Billie Holiday
signature_cocktails.brief: Rum-led and fruit-bright with soft tropical sweetness and an easygoing finish.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: Billie Holiday is a rum-led, fruit-bright cocktail with soft tropical sweetness.

signature_cocktails.name: Prince Pimms
signature_cocktails.brief: Crisp, cool, and refreshing with garden notes and a lively ginger sparkle.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: Prince Pimms is crisp, cool, garden-fresh, and ginger-sparkly — a strong refreshing pick.

signature_cocktails.name: Esplanade Lemonade
signature_cocktails.brief: Pink, juicy, and patio-friendly with berry brightness and a fizzy citrus close.
signature_cocktails.guest_answer: Esplanade Lemonade is pink, juicy, fizzy, berry-bright, and citrusy — one of the easiest sweet-refreshing picks.

menu_answers.overview: BMC has specialty craft cocktails, THC seltzers, craft beer, and fresh-made-to-order chicken paninis from the patio backbar. Ask by mood: sweet, refreshing, whiskey, gin, rum, dessert, or tropical.
menu_answers.sweet: For sweeter drinks, start with Esplanade Lemonade, Billie Holiday, Muddy Waters, or Uptown Funk.
menu_answers.refreshing: For refreshing drinks, ask about The BMC, Jimi Hendrix Fizz, Prince Pimms, Esplanade Lemonade, or Uptown Funk.
menu_answers.whiskey: For whiskey, ask about the Etta Jameson: smooth, warm, softly sweet, and tangy on the finish.
menu_answers.gin: For gin, ask about the Jimi Hendrix Fizz. The BMC can also be made with gin if you want the house cocktail in a brighter mint-citrus lane.
menu_answers.rum: For rum, ask about Billie Holiday. The BMC can also be made with rum if you want the house cocktail with mint and citrus.
menu_answers.tequila: For tequila, ask for The BMC with tequila: cool, minty, bright, and citrusy.
menu_answers.vodka: For vodka, ask for The BMC with vodka: clean, bright, minty, and citrusy.
menu_answers.thc: BMC carries THC seltzers when available. Ask the bar what is cold today.
menu_answers.beer: BMC carries craft beer. Ask the bar for the current craft selections.
